# Saints Row (Xbox 360, 2006) - ReXGlue Static Recompilation Project
#
# SDK boilerplate lives in generated/rexglue.cmake (auto-generated by codegen).

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.25)
project(saintsrow LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 23)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)

include(generated/rexglue.cmake)

set(SAINTSROW_SOURCES
    src/main.cpp
    src/stubs.cpp
)

if(WIN32)
    add_executable(saintsrow WIN32 ${SAINTSROW_SOURCES})
else()
    add_executable(saintsrow ${SAINTSROW_SOURCES})
endif()

rexglue_setup_target(saintsrow GPU_PLUGINS xenos)

target_compile_options(saintsrow PRIVATE -fno-strict-aliasing -ffp-model=strict -fno-char8_t)

# Our stubs deliberately override weak recomp/kernel symbols.
if(WIN32)
    target_link_options(saintsrow PRIVATE "LINKER:/force:multiple" "LINKER:/STACK:16777216")
endif()

# A build with none of the game-specific overrides (see the top of stubs.cpp).
option(SAINTSROW_BARE "Build without the game-specific stub overrides" OFF)
if(SAINTSROW_BARE)
    target_compile_definitions(saintsrow PRIVATE SR_BARE)
endif()
